title: Mail
subtitle: Inboxes for you, your team and your agents.
disabled: Mail is not enabled on this installation yet.

emptyFolderBody: Receiving and sending will be enabled after the email service is configured.
choose: Choose a mailbox to view its preparation
privateBody: Managing the registry does not automatically grant access to personal mailbox content. Only the responsible person and authorized people gain access.
preparingBody: The address is reserved. Receiving, sending and email clients still await activation.
name: Mailbox name
createHint: Registration reserves the address; it does not change DNS or enable receiving.
noDomains: Add a domain to the organization to prepare your first mailbox.
domainNote: Domain sending verification is separate from receiving configuration.

conflict: This address is already reserved. Choose a different address.
accessHint: Permissions apply to this mailbox only and cease when a person leaves the organization. They do not enable sending.
ownerMissing: A responsible person needs to be assigned
registeredBody: Responsible person, domain and permissions defined.
transportBody: Next: email service and private messages.
clientsBody: IMAP/JMAP and API/MCP will be connected after mailbox qualification.
managementOnly: You manage the registry; reading requires mailbox authorization.
pausedBody: Access to this mailbox is suspended. An administrator can review the registry.

restoredNotice: Message restored to its original folder.

person.title: Mailboxes for people
person.body: Select a personal mailbox or create an address for your team. Reading requires mailbox authorization.

agent.title: Your agents' mail
agent.body: Select an agent mailbox to follow its messages. The mailbox owner controls who can read, draft and send.

approval.requestedNotice: The agent {label} asked you to approve sending this draft. Check the recipients and the text and click Send; to decline, edit or delete the draft.
approval.requestedNoticeUnnamed: An agent asked you to approve sending this draft. Check the recipients and the text and click Send; to decline, edit or delete the draft.

safety.spamBody: This message is separated from the Inbox. The owner can move it back before replying or forwarding.
safety.quarantineBody: Security checks have blocked this content. It cannot be opened, replied to, forwarded or released from the dashboard.
safety.blockedPreview: The content remains private and unavailable for reading.
safety.spamEmptyBody: Messages separated from the Inbox as spam will appear in this folder.
safety.quarantineEmptyBody: This folder shows records of messages blocked by security checks without opening their content.
safety.moveError: The folder change could not be confirmed. Refresh messages before trying again.

results.title: Send results
results.accepted: The service accepted this send. Delivery to recipients is confirmed separately.
results.empty: No later result has been confirmed.
results.unavailable: Recipient tracking is unavailable for this send.
results.noReading: Delivery to the recipient server does not confirm that the message was read.

setup.title: Create email on your domain
setup.description: Choose the domain, check the license and create an address for a person or agent. Registration reserves the address; activation is checked separately.
setup.newAddressHint: This address can be new. You do not need to create it with another provider first.
setup.displayNameHint: This name appears in the dashboard. If left empty, we use the address name.
setup.personBody: For you or a teammate to read and reply in the dashboard.
setup.agentBody: For an agent to work with messages through the API, with access limited to this mailbox.
setup.kindHint: Both types use mailboxes with sending, receiving and storage. Connecting an agent is a separate step.
setup.ownerHint: This person controls access, including when the mailbox is used by an agent.
setup.licenseReady: A seat is available. Registering reserves one mailbox on your license.
setup.systemLicenseReady: Your System license allows unlimited mailboxes without a paid subscription or monthly sending cap. Check the available storage below; each address needs sending and receiving configured.
setup.licenseRequired: Creation requires an active license with an available seat.
setup.sendingVerified: This domain is verified for sending. The mailbox also depends on service activation.
setup.sendingPending: This domain must be verified before sending. You can reserve the address now.
setup.receivingBody: Receiving depends on DNS (MX) and domain rules. Sending verification does not confirm this configuration.
setup.reservationBody: This step registers the mailbox and reserves the address. Sending and receiving activation are checked separately; registering does not change your current provider.
setup.savedDescription: Registration is confirmed. You can now follow your mailbox setup.
setup.nextBody: The address is reserved. To use the mailbox, confirm domain sending, receiving, the resource policy and activation of this new address.
setup.agentNext: For an agent to use this mailbox, authorize a connection with the required permissions. Creating the address does not grant agent access.

loading.title: Checking your license
loading.body: Wait for seat availability to be confirmed before registering.

error.title: Seat availability could not be checked

inactive.title: An active license is required
inactive.body: Check your Mail license before registering a mailbox.

full.title: All seats are occupied
full.body: Your license has {used} of {total} mailboxes reserved. Review the license before registering another.

errors.addressInvalid: Enter only the name before @: unaccented letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores. Start and end with a letter or number.
errors.ownerInvalid: Choose a person in the organization to own this mailbox.
errors.conflict: This address is already reserved. Choose another name or check your mailboxes.
errors.quota: Another mailbox took the last seat. Review your license; your entered details remain here.
errors.notEntitled: The license does not allow mailbox creation now. Check its status; your entered details remain here.
errors.invalid: Check the address, mailbox name and responsible person.
errors.error: Registration could not be confirmed. Your entered details remain here. Check your mailboxes before trying again.
errors.domainInvalid: Choose an organization domain to continue.

setup.domainBody: The domain defines the address after @. Sending verification and receiving setup are separate steps.
setup.existingProviderBody: Already receiving email with another provider (Google, Microsoft…)? Use a subdomain just for Correio, such as agents.yourdomain.com. Changing the MX records of your main domain redirects all of its incoming email to MepMail, and registration does not migrate old messages.

receiving.unknown: Receiving setup has not been confirmed. Check DNS (MX) and service activation before using this domain.
receiving.needs_mx: DNS (MX) still needs to be configured to receive with MepMail. You can reserve the address while preparing this step.
receiving.needs_activation: Receiving activation is still pending. Reserving the address does not complete this setup.
receiving.ready: The service confirmed receiving setup for this domain. Each new address still requires activation.

setup.noDomainsBody: Add the domain you bought or already use to your organization. Then return to create your email.
setup.systemResourceLimitsBody: Internal use has no monthly sending cap. Messages and drafts use mailbox storage; technical limits, provider capacity and abuse protections remain in place.
setup.resourceLimitsBody: These are the current resource allowances per mailbox. Sending counts recipients and requires an active operational cycle. Messages and drafts use the mailbox storage.
setup.resourcePolicyPending: The resource policy must be active to send or receive new messages. You can reserve the address before then.
setup.receivingError: Receiving could not be confirmed. Check again before using this domain.
setup.activationHint: After your license, domain and MX are confirmed, activate receiving for this domain’s licensed mailboxes. DNS is managed separately.
setup.activationError: Receiving activation could not be confirmed. Your address remains reserved. Check receiving before trying again.
setup.activationPending: Receiving is still pending. Review the domain configuration and service availability, then check again.
setup.activationReady: Receiving has been confirmed for your mailbox.

organization.chooseBox: Choose a mailbox to see folders for this person or agent.
organization.emptyFolders: Organize this mailbox with your own folders.
organization.folderHelp: This folder belongs to this mailbox. Use names such as Customers, Finance or Leads to organize conversations.
organization.archiveHelp: “{name}” will no longer appear. Messages return to their default folders without being deleted. Messages in Trash stay in Trash.
organization.conflict: Something changed since your last read. Refresh and try again.
organization.error: Could not organize this mailbox. Refresh before trying again.
organization.bulkTrashed: {count, plural, one {# message moved} other {# messages moved}} to Trash.
organization.bulkRestored: {count, plural, one {# message restored} other {# messages restored}}.
organization.bulkPartial: {count, number} of {total, number} messages changed. Refresh to check the remaining messages before trying again.
organization.trashHelp: Messages are preserved here. Select one or more to restore them to their original folder.
organization.limitedList: Showing the most recent messages. Choose a mailbox or folder to narrow this list.
organization.bulkMarkedRead: {count, plural, one {# message marked as read} other {# messages marked as read}}.
organization.bulkMarkedUnread: {count, plural, one {# message marked as unread} other {# messages marked as unread}}.
organization.bulkArchived: {count, plural, one {# message archived} other {# messages archived}}.
organization.dropDone: {count, plural, one {# message moved} other {# messages moved}}.
organization.dropNone: Those messages are already there or can't go to that folder.

usage.title: Usage
usage.internalHelp: Total outbound usage. The system account has no monthly allowance.
usage.outboundHelp: Usage in the period, including queued sends. Messages and attachments in Trash use storage.
usage.empty: Choose an available mailbox to check usage.
usage.allBoxes: Sum of the mailboxes you can open

offer.title: Mailboxes for you and your agents
offer.body: Real addresses on your own domain for people and AI agents to receive, read and reply to email — from the dashboard or through the API.

points.addresses: Person and agent mailboxes on your verified domain, with folders, search and attachments.
points.agents: Per-mailbox API keys for agents, with a sending allowance on each mailbox.
points.price: {small} for {smallPrice} or {large} for {largePrice} per mailbox a month.

offer.requirement: Correio is an add-on to the paid Send plans, from {price} a month. Eligible new customers pay {first} for the first month of Send.
offer.adminOnly: Ask a team owner or admin to subscribe.

app.boxesHint: Your team's mailboxes on your domains. Manage name, owner and signature, or check each one's receiving (MX).
app.agentsHint: Keys for agents to work in your mailboxes, over MCP or the API. Without the send permission, the agent asks for your approval before sending.
app.agentsEmpty: You don't own a mailbox yet.

archiveEmptyBody: Archive messages to take them out of the Inbox without deleting them. They stay here.

signature.title: Signature for {address}
signature.lead: Shown at the end of the emails you write: formatted for recipients, and as text for those who don't read HTML.
signature.name: Name
signature.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP. We size it for email and send it as PNG.
signature.logoTooLarge: That image is too large. Use a smaller logo.
signature.logoInvalid: That image could not be read. Use PNG, JPG or WebP.
signature.logoError: The logo could not be saved. Try again.
signature.logoUnavailable: Logo uploads are not available on this server.
signature.previewGreeting: …and the end of your email looks like this:
signature.invalid: Check the phone (digits, +, -, parentheses only) and the website.
signature.error: The signature could not be saved. Try again.

recipientLimit: Up to 20 recipients across To and Cc.
